working: Summary line of a socio's (AI agent's) turn while it runs; count is how many steps (tool calls, thoughts) so far.
worked-through: Summary line of a finished turn whose duration is unknown; count is how many steps.
worked-for: Summary line of a finished turn; {{duration}} is how long it worked, already formatted ("34s", "2m 5s"); count is how many steps.
failed-count: After the summary line: how many steps failed.
thinking: The model is reasoning right now.
thought-for: {{duration}} is how long the model reasoned, already formatted ("12s").
step.running: Accessible name of the spinner on a step still running.
open-dataset: Link after a notice that the socio wrote to a shared dataset; it opens that dataset.
details.input: Heading of what the tool was given.
details.result: Heading of what the tool returned.
details.loading-whole: {{size}} is the whole result's size, such as "12 KB" (see kilobytes).
details.partial: Only a preview of a long result shows; a Try again button follows.
details.show-lines: Button under a cut code block; count is how many lines it has.
details.show-characters: Button under a cut one-line block; count is how many characters it has.
details.more: Under a cut list of found items; count is how many aren't shown. "Copy" refers to the copy button, which copies them all.
details.item: Stands in for a found item without a title; {{position}} is its place in the list (1, 2…).
details.kilobytes: A size in kilobytes; {{kb}} is the number.
details.binary: A field holding encoded data (an image, a file's bytes), not shown; {{size}} is its size, such as "40 KB".
fields.stdout: The fields.* keys: Names of a tool's fields, where the field's own name (shown as is otherwise) would read badly. stdout and stderr are a command's output and errors; timeout-ms is a time limit in milliseconds.
image.screenshot: Name of an image a tool returned without one (a screenshot of the socio's computer).
image.view: Accessible name of the thumbnail that opens the image full size; {{name}} is the image's name.
image.missing: In place of an image that couldn't load.
